title: fix(app-shell): a state machine row's Next states box in Studio keeps a typed comma
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao5S6gNFvmKHxrqpXWgottKg)_

Fixes #36733

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 管理员在 Studio 的校验规则面板里给状态机规则填“下一状态”时,逐键输入逗号不再被吞,能填出两个及以上的下一状态。
- 属于 Studio 规则编辑体验的修补,替在 Studio 里定义状态流转的管理员解决输入问题。
- 出错时只影响这个输入框的显示与写入,不改存储格式,可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `TransitionsField` in `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx`: the row's "Next states" box keeps its own typed text while it is being edited (per-row `editing` state: row index + text). Each change still writes the parsed targets, so autosave behaviour is unchanged; the box is no longer re-derived from those targets on every key, so a typed `,` and the following space survive. On blur the box shows the targets again. Deleting a row clears the held text, since the rows below move up an index.
- PR #36719's behaviour is kept: the `''` target stays the row's "May be cleared" checkbox, and editing the box keeps it (`rowTargets(..., to.includes(''))` unchanged).
- A patch changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Tests
- New pin `ObjectValidationsPanel.typedComma-36733.test.tsx`: types `done, closed` one key at a time (`fireEvent.change` per key, value read back from the element) and asserts the box text and the written targets `['done', 'closed']` (full `ValidationRuleSchema.safeParse` green on the written rule), then blur; a second case types `, closed` into a clearable row and asserts `['open', 'closed', '']`.
- Ablation (one): the `value` restored to `to.filter((s) => s !== '').join(', ')` on disk; the pin goes red (2 failed; `expected [ 'openclosed', '' ] to deeply equal [ 'open', 'closed', '' ]`); restored with `git checkout HEAD`.
- Existing pins `clearableState-36567` and `newRuleComplete-26731` unchanged and green.
